title: Make the local checklist green on a clean main
problem: On a clean main in a web session, 26 gitops/tests/test_worker_run.py tests fail because `gh` is preinstalled, and the platform/ci loop uses `|| break`, so it stops at the first failing module and hides the rest. A session cannot tell its own regression from the baseline.
evidence: gitops/tests/test_worker_run.py friction report: python3 prompts/promptctl.py measure (doc friction), 2026-10-15
change: Make test_worker_run.py independent of a preinstalled gh (or skip with a named reason), and change the loop to run every module and report all failures.
metric: Local checklist exit code on clean main

history.note: test_worker_run.py now green with a preinstalled gh (worker.sh WORKER_PATH_PREFIX, set by the test harness); CLAUDE.md platform/ci loop runs every module and lists failures. Still open: 4 platform/ci modules fail on clean main (test_check_money_sign, test_check_step_grid, test_publish_surface, test_validate_workflows), so the checklist exit code is still non-zero.

Fixed test_check_money_sign (fix_money_sign.mjs on 2 ventures), test_check_step_grid (step="any" on 15 inputs in 11 ventures), test_validate_workflows job-cap (deploy-iac-check timeout). Still red on clean main: test_publish_surface (9 unclassified workflows + KeyError 'application' in snapshot) and test_validate_workflows venture-tests-run-somewhere (421 ventures with no CI workflow).
